Author: @eldritchthorne
Comment: As a book and art lover, I adore this. Those who say that "books are expensive" don't know where to look as buying them brand new is just a waste when there are thousand+ of copies secondhand. Between the library selling off extra copies of books, clearances at bookstores, and secondhand shops/places like Goodwill, there's really no need to pay full price. I'd love to see something like this done with a copy of The Phantom of the Opera or E.A.P.'s short stories.
